name: Anchor Method
overview: Installation of high-tensile anchor rods and chemical anchors to securely fasten displaced structural elements or fix seismic tie-backs.
principle: Mechanical shear and tension transfer across the contact interface using resin capsules or epoxy injection anchors.

name: Bolt Replacement Method
overview: Removal of rusted, yielded, or sheared high-strength friction grip (HSFG) bolts and replacement with torque-calibrated Grade 10.9 assemblies.
principle: Restores full frictional and shear load transfer across splice plates through precise calibrated torque tightening.

name: Correction Method
overview: Hydraulic jacking, mechanical realigning, and localized heat straightening to restore bent or deflected members to design tolerances.
principle: Controlled plastic deformation under hydraulic pressure accompanied by cooling flame straightening cycles.

name: Cross-Sectional Restoration Method
overview: Removal of delaminated concrete, anti-corrosion passivation of exposed steel reinforcement, and polymer-modified mortar or micro-concrete patching.
principle: Restores structural protective cover and cross-sectional geometry, arresting environmental chloride and moisture ingress.

name: External Cable Installation Method
overview: Installation of external high-tensile post-tensioning strands anchored to steel cross-beams or internal deviation blocks inside girder cells.
principle: Imparts positive upward camber and compression to counteract excessive dead/live load mid-span flexural moments.

name: Fastening Method Using Reinforcement Bolts
overview: Reinforcing loose or undersized joints using high-strength through-bolts and heavy backing plates.
principle: Clamping force generation preventing relative micro-movement and fatigue tearing under dynamic traffic pulses.

name: Fiber Plate Adhesive Method (CFRP Plates)
overview: Bonding pultruded Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) plates to tension zones using high-modulus thixotropic structural epoxy.
principle: External tension reinforcement with 2,800+ MPa tensile strength, dramatically increasing moment capacity without dead weight penalty.

name: Fiber Sheet Adhesive Method (CFRP/GFRP Wrap)
overview: Wet lay-up of bi-directional or uni-directional carbon fiber fabrics wrapped around circular or rectangular pier shafts.
principle: Provides hoop confinement stress to concrete cores, increasing axial load ductility and shear resistance.

name: Filling Method
overview: Cleaning and scraping shallow surface depressions, then filling with self-leveling cementitious or polyurethane grout compounds.
principle: Eliminates standing water retention zones and prevents freeze-thaw/moisture erosion cycles.

name: Injection Method (Epoxy / Polyurethane)
overview: Low-pressure continuous injection of low-viscosity structural epoxy or hydrophilic expanding polyurethane into cracks >= 0.2mm.
principle: Re-bonds cracked concrete monolithic sections and seals interior rebar from moisture, oxygen, and carbon dioxide.

name: Plate Bonding Method (Steel Plate Bonding)
overview: Epoxy-adhering and chemical-anchor bolting 6mm to 12mm structural steel plates to concrete faces under uniform pressure.
principle: Direct composite load sharing, boosting section modulus and limiting crack opening under overload vehicle passages.

name: Prestressing Method
overview: Re-tensioning existing adjustable post-tensioning anchors or adding supplemental unbonded monostrand tendons.
principle: Restores designed residual compressive pre-stress into tension zones.

name: Reinforcement by Installation Method
overview: Erecting supplemental structural steel props, bracing trusses, or gabion rock-mattress aprons at critical nodes.
principle: Redistributes critical load paths away from fatigued or undermined elements.

name: Replacement Method (Bearings & Joints)
overview: Hydraulic synchronized bridge deck jacking (500t jacks), extraction of damaged elastomeric/pot bearings, and seating of new type-tested bearings.
principle: Restores frictionless thermal expansion/contraction movement and seismic damping.

name: Steel Bridge Painting
overview: Grit blasting to Sa 2.5 standard, followed by zinc-rich primer, epoxy intermediate micaceous iron oxide coat, and aliphatic polyurethane topcoat.
principle: High-durability barrier and cathodic protection preventing atmospheric oxidation.

name: Stop-Hole Method
overview: Precision magnetic core drilling of a 16mm-25mm hole exactly at the detected fatigue crack tip to eliminate notch stress concentration.
principle: Transforms singular infinite stress notch into a blunt circular boundary with low elastic stress concentration factor.

name: Surface Treatment Method (Silane Impregnation)
overview: High-pressure water jet cleaning followed by spray flooding of 100% active octyltriethoxysilane deep-penetrating water repellent.
principle: Chemically bonds inside concrete pore walls creating a hydrophobic microscopic barrier permeable to vapor but impermeable to liquid water and salts.

name: Welding Repair Method
overview: Carbon-arc gouging of cracked weld seams, preheating to 150°C, and manual shielded metal arc welding (SMAW) with low-hydrogen E7018 electrodes.
principle: Restores full metallurgical continuity and parent metal yield strength.
